verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a cloud-backed remote-access and IT-management SaaS like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection or storage location. The pricing and homepage items cover SSO, audit logs, AI features and device management, and none of them address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
